facts.function: components of an electric fuel pump
facts.form: separate parts: capacitor, valve plate, valve seat, valve body, protective cap
facts.end_use: electric fuel pump for an internal combustion piston engine (assumed)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8413 covers pumps for liquids and parts thereof; 8413.30 fuel pumps for internal combustion piston engines
Section XVI note 2(b): parts solely or principally for a particular pump go with that pump
GRI 6: 8413.91 parts of pumps; 8413.91.90 Other; line Of subheading 8413.30.90 (old 8413.91.90.10 moved to .15 per hts_revision_diff)

rejected_alternatives.reason: capacitor has its own heading 8532 under Section XVI note 2(a), but the description treats all items as parts of the fuel pump and lists several articles; classified as pump parts
for compression-ignition fuel-injection pumps, not stated
valve parts: considered but they are parts of the pump here

missing_facts: classify separately: capacitor (heading 8532), valve body/seat/plate as valve parts (8481.90) if imported separately
pump type: for internal combustion engine or not
classification.rationale: Parts of electric fuel pumps for piston engines fall under 8413.91.90 Of subheading 8413.30.90. N011941 classified fuel pump parts in the old equivalent 8413.91.9010; that line now exists as 8413.91.90.15. The capacitor could go to 8532 if entered separately.
